## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change; `gofmt`, `go vet`, `staticcheck` and `govulncheck` pass
- [ ] New source files start with the SPDX license header
- [ ] User-visible changes are in CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased
- [ ] The documentation is updated (README.md, docs/: quickstart, design, protocol, apps; lite/README.md)
- [ ] No secrets, real addresses or device names
